header.tagline: Program Manager | Technology Ecosystems, Partnerships & GTM | Co-founder, Bengaluru Tech Week

paragraphs: I am a program manager who works across partnerships, GTM and technology ecosystems. As a co-founder of Bengaluru Tech Week, I helped turn a citywide idea into a coordinated programme of 100+ independently hosted technology events in 2026.

At Amazon, I work across sales, account management and growth for high-value sellers in India. I have acquired and expanded 80+ strategic accounts, added 10,000+ listings, unblocked 500+ listings and influenced 90M+ in GMS through consultative partner engagement.
My strength is bringing structure to complex work: aligning stakeholders, turning goals into operating plans, tracking delivery and keeping teams moving from idea to execution.

items.name: Bengaluru Tech Week
description: Co-led planning and delivery of a citywide technology programme spanning 100+ independently hosted events, 80+ hosts and 300+ speakers.
Coordinated partners, hosts, speakers, volunteers, venues and community stakeholders across concurrent workstreams.
Built operating rhythms for programme reviews, listing approvals, partner follow-ups, communications and delivery tracking.

items.name: International Account Programmes
description: Managed key accounts across Indonesia, the Philippines, Africa and KSA.

responsibilities: Co-lead planning and delivery of a citywide technology programme spanning 100+ independently hosted events, 80+ hosts and 300+ speakers.
Coordinate partners, event hosts, speakers, volunteers, venues and community stakeholders across concurrent workstreams.
Manage programme reviews, listing approvals, partner follow-ups, communications, delivery tracking and on-ground issue resolution.
Manage a portfolio of strategic seller accounts and coordinate growth workstreams across selection, listings, inventory, advertising and account health.
Work across internal teams and external stakeholders to diagnose blockers, prioritise interventions and track outcomes.
Use seller feedback and operational data to identify recurring issues and improve execution.
Worked with Amazon's Surgical Acquisition and Selection team to bridge consumer demand and marketplace supply by identifying selection gaps.
Onboarded new selections to the Amazon marketplace and managed account performance to maximize sales and brand presence.
Improved seller outcomes through ad campaign optimization, listing quality enhancement, inventory optimization, glance-view focus and account health management.
Managed the sales process in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Used export tools and global trade analysis to build strategies for deal closure, customer account analysis, upselling and cross-selling.
Managed key accounts for Indonesia, the Philippines, Africa and KSA, including RFQs, competitive quotations, purchase orders, export invoices, Incoterms and delivery coordination.
